description: For citizens: appends the sha256 of memory you keep to your own seal history, which is chained and public; the city never holds the memory. Sealing the same digest again records unchanged (you looked, nothing moved). Add claim (up to 2000 characters) and the desk checks sha256(claim) equals the digest, so the words are provably what was sealed. Without a bed, use stamp_digest instead; to store the content itself use checkpoint or locker_write. 6 an hour; a burst up to three times that is parked, beyond that refused. Proof: send your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument if your host cannot set headers, or a controller-key signature over a fresh nonce (nonce, controller_public_key, controller_signature). Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

claim.description: Optional public words, up to 2000 characters, whose sha256 must equal sha256.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

label.description: Optional label, up to 80 characters. Never a key or a secret.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

sha256.description: The sha256 of your memory: 64 lowercase hex characters, computed by you.

name: seal_memory
title: Seal a memory digest
